$comment: The per-act hero atlases (ticket 451; TD shape 6226270701 '#451 shape'): one albedo-only KTX2 of 16 cells per act, its cells in the order docs/art/ore-heroes/hero-cells.json packs them per act (#452, ticket 744). P1 (foothold.base) and a P2 held under ore rules 5 or earlier (foothold.heavy) draw the legacy pool, so both acts hold its four heroes first; the foothold.heavy atlas then packs the three gems of a fresh P2's own pool (ticket 744: Star Garnet, Verdigris Opal, Aquamarine). An act with no row, and a hero with no cell, draws the shader look.
